source_identity.title: Phosphorus Recovery from Sewage Sludge Using Acidithiobacilli
source_identity.version: Published journal article, 13 pages; new PDF/XML bytes match round86 downloads. Crossref deposited 2025-10-11 and indexed 2026-09-19 are metadata timestamps, not a new assay or article edition.

method_scope.feed: Partially dewatered Lehtoniemi wastewater-treatment-plant sludge, Kuopio, Finland; 5.59% total solids, total-P 2 g/L fresh weight, PO4-P 130 mg/L fresh weight (Table 1).
method_scope.inocula: A. ferrooxidans DSM 29444 and A. thiooxidans DSM 14887; separate cultures grown 15 days at 30 C in DSMZ 882 or 71. Equal-volume mixed inoculum in FT.
method_scope.bottle: 250 mL loosely closed bottle, initially 90 mL medium/inoculum/water and 10 mL sludge; 30 C, 150 rpm.
method_scope.timeline: Phase 1 days 0-21; phase 2 days 21-42; phase 3 days 42-63. Explicit 10 mL mixture removed and 10 mL fresh sludge added at days 21 and 42. At day 42 add nominal 10 g/L elemental sulfur, described as Fluka 80% pure; do not infer a purity-corrected dose.
method_scope.controls: O water plus sludge, FC DSMZ 882 plus sludge, TC DSMZ 71 plus sludge, FTC 50:50 media plus sludge; no added culture in these arms. Source explicitly reports indigenous sulfur/iron oxidizers in medium controls, without molecular identification. These are neither sterile sludge controls nor nutrient-only blanks.
method_scope.analysis: Section 2.2: total-reflection X-ray fluorescence after acid digestion for total heavy metals, total-S and total-P; Hach spectrophotometry for total-N, PO4-P, soluble Fe, sulfate and total-P. Section 2.6: remaining solution filtered at 0.45 micrometres, soluble fraction analyzed; no isolated P product measured.
method_scope.sampling: Section 2.6 specifies pH measurements two or three times weekly but no withdrawal volume for these checks; sections 2.2-2.3 report phase-end chemistry and microbial measurements without a complete bottle-volume/sample-mass ledger. Section 2.5's 0.1 mL plate/MPN inoculum aliquots do not define the complete 63-day chemistry sampling inventory.
method_scope.replicates: Tables 2 and 4 say N=3 for microbial enumerations; chemistry tables give no per-replicate values. Figures show error bars without a raw replicate key or error-definition statement in their captions. No extrapolated replicate count or uncertainty assigned to Table 5 percentages.
method_scope.raw_data: Section 2.7 mentions an Excel file and SPSS 25. Data Availability Statement says Not applicable. No file accession, nutrient blank table or underlying workbook link appears in inspected primary artifacts.

source_inspection.figure1_note: Approximate visual readings of the final plotted marker for each indicated phase (days 21, 42, 63), not digitized raw pH data. Legends and phase boundaries checked on PDF page 6; Table 5 on page 8. No plotted value replaces the table.

figure2.caption_scope: Total P in sludge/solution at beginning of each phase; soluble PO4-P in filtered supernatant at phase ends.
figure2.relation_to_table5: Table 5 reports 92% T and 19% FT. Multiplying by reported 501 mg/L gives conditional 460.92 and 95.19 mg/L. These are not identical to the apparent plotted centers. Total-P versus PO4-P, sample IDs, replicate weighting, uncertainty and denominator processing remain unresolved, so this is a reconciliation request, not a corrected table or demonstrated specific arithmetic error.

medium_context.source: DSMZ Medium 71 PDF currently served by article reference 18 URL
medium_context.difference: 3.00 g KH2PO4 and 5.00 g Na2S2O3.5H2O per final 1000 mL. Paper describes 900 mL solution A with KH2PO4 3 g/L plus 100 mL solution B with thiosulfate pentahydrate 3.2 g/L. Current PDF also says static incubation and 5% CO2 for DSM 14887; paper's leaching bottles are shaken at 150 rpm. These are current culture instructions, not proof that the published experiment used them.

medium_context.source: DSMZ Medium 882 PDF currently served by article reference 16 URL
medium_context.difference: Current PDF combines 950 mL A, 50 mL B and 1 mL C, final 1001 mL; A contains 27 mg KH2PO4 in 950 mL, B contains 20 g FeSO4.7H2O in 50 mL 0.25 N H2SO4, trace solution uses MnCl2.4H2O. Paper says 950+49+1 mL, A 27 mg KH2PO4/L, B 20 g FeSO4.7H2O/L, and MnCl2.2H2O. Do not substitute current masses, hydrate or acidity into historical run metadata.

source_inspection.acceptance: No raw nutrient blanks, full sampling/replacement ledger, raw P numerator/denominator spreadsheet, linked correction or authenticated public clarification was obtained within the documented bounds. Preserve source-only status and existing qualified owner; no owner patch proposed.
